name: yugioh-collection-manager
description: A full-stack Yu-Gi-Oh! card collection manager with React frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.docker:logs:backend: docker compose logs -f backend || docker-compose logs -f backend
scripts.docker:logs:frontend: docker compose logs -f frontend || docker-compose logs -f frontend
scripts.docker:clean: (docker compose down && docker system prune -f) || (docker-compose down && docker system prune -f)
scripts.docker:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up || docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
scripts.docker:dev:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build || docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.docker:dev:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down || docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run docker:build
scripts.clean:install: npm run clean && npm run install:all
